import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
context=json.loads(Path("/tmp/opencode/managed-20261023-integrate-manual-01/context.json").read_text())
report=json.loads(Path(context["report"]).read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
identities={p:sha(p) for p in sorted(context["ownedPaths"]) if Path(p).exists()}
codeId=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()
assert report["candidate"]["codeId"]=="sha256:"+codeId
assert report["mode"]=="integration" and not any(k in report for k in ["proposal","implementationUnits","ancestorClosures"])
paths=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","HEAD","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines())|set(subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard"],text=True).splitlines())
paths.add("docs/agent/implementation-runs/managed-20261023-integrate-manual-01/candidate-identity.json")
assert paths==set(report["changedPaths"])
owned=set(context["ownedPaths"])
for run in context["inheritPathsFrom"]:
    owned.update(json.loads(Path("docs/agent/implementation-runs/"+run+".json").read_text())["changedPaths"])
assert all(p in owned or p==context["report"] or p.startswith("docs/agent/implementation-runs/"+context["runId"]+"/") for p in paths)
assert subprocess.call(["git","diff","--check"])==0
print(json.dumps({"candidateCodeId":codeId,"codeInputs":identities,"changedPaths":sorted(paths),"limit":"Merge-only content/path provenance; not independent verification or application-state validation."},indent=2))
